components.ownership: Generated per entity. Holds the column values of a new or loaded row and the chain state in its Core.
components.ownership_ko: 엔티티마다 생성된다. 새 행이나 조회한 행의 컬럼 값과 체인 상태를 Core에 담는다.

components.ownership: Stores the chain state and builds a value-free request with a separate parameter list.
components.ownership_ko: 체인 상태를 저장하고 값이 없는 request와 별도의 parameter 목록을 만든다.

components.ownership: The request shape is the plan cache key; values stay in the parameter list.
components.ownership_ko: request 모양이 plan cache key이며 값은 parameter 목록에만 있다.

components.ownership: The common request shape of every client.
components.ownership_ko: 모든 client에 공통인 request 모양이다.

components.ownership: The root, a join child, a relation child, or a subquery.
components.ownership_ko: root, join child, relation child, subquery 중 하나다.

components.ownership: Runs in the client process. Validates a request against the manifest and renders the dialect SQL.
components.ownership_ko: client process 안에서 실행된다. manifest로 request를 검증하고 dialect SQL을 만든다.

components.ownership: Immutable statements and assembly metadata cached per request shape.
components.ownership_ko: request 모양별로 cache하는 불변 statement와 조립 정보다.

components.ownership: One SQL statement of a plan.
components.ownership_ko: plan의 SQL statement 하나다.

components.ownership: Maps result columns by position to models, joins, and relations.
components.ownership_ko: 결과 컬럼을 위치로 model, join, relation에 대응시킨다.

components.ownership: Owns the pool, the planners of registered schemas, and the plan and statement caches.
components.ownership_ko: pool, 등록된 schema의 planner, plan cache, statement cache를 가진다.

components.ownership: Private. The transaction of the current execution flow; models without a connection use it.
components.ownership_ko: 비공개다. 현재 실행 흐름의 transaction이며 연결 없는 model이 사용한다.

components.ownership: Ordered models keyed by primary key, keyName, or fetchKey.
components.ownership_ko: primary key, keyName, fetchKey로 key를 정한 순서 있는 model 목록이다.

components.ownership: The rows and counts of getsPage.
components.ownership_ko: getsPage의 행과 개수다.

components.ownership: Connection utilities; lock and local values need an active transaction.
components.ownership_ko: 연결 유틸리티다. lock과 local 값은 진행 중인 transaction이 필요하다.

components.ownership: Installs a manifest with the client DDL renderer.
components.ownership_ko: client DDL 렌더러로 manifest를 설치한다.

components.ownership: Reports and rotates AES key versions of a model table.
components.ownership_ko: model 테이블의 AES key version을 조회하고 회전한다.

components.ownership: Keys by version; the current version encrypts new values.
components.ownership_ko: version별 key다. 현재 version으로 새 값을 암호화한다.

components.ownership: Row counts per key version.
components.ownership_ko: key version별 행 수다.

components.ownership: One per language. Reads schema.json and emits models; Go and Rust emit only the chain methods the sources call.
components.ownership_ko: 언어마다 하나다. schema.json을 읽어 model을 만든다. Go와 Rust는 소스가 호출하는 체인 메서드만 만든다.

components.ownership: A stable code from docs/errors.yaml.
components.ownership_ko: docs/errors.yaml의 안정적인 code다.

inventory_policy.compare: exact declarations; missing, added, moved, retyped or re-owned symbols fail
inventory_policy.runtime_bodies: Validated by conformance vectors and client database suites, not by declaration snapshots.
inventory_policy.update: Change the common contract first; record candidates explicitly, review their diff, then pass all language gates.
inventory_policy.generated_models: Go snapshots the generated bench models; PHP and TypeScript snapshot the runtime base class; Rust snapshots the orm-build template of the fixed model methods.
